newsitem.title: USA: Committees expect to take up U.S. budget Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Committees expect to take up U.S. budget Thursday.

text.p: The U.S. Senate and House Budget Committees were expected to take up consideration of a federal budget blueprint Thursday, the chairmen of the two committees said Wednesday.

Senate Budget Committee Chairman Pete Domenici said a budget resolution would likely be taken up by his committee Thursday. Congressional and White House budget negotiators are still working to iron out some lingering differences in the budget agreement announced May 2.

"The documentation ... is being written up, prepared," the New Mexico Republican told Reuters. "As soon as we get this we're going to have to look it over and then be meeting with our leaders," he said.

House Budget Committee Chairman John Kasich, an Ohio Republican, said earlier that he also believed his committee would consider the budget resolution Thursday, with a possibility it could even occur later Wednesday.
